CudaVox · PyPI
CudaVox is a python package that provides bindings to c++ code using pybind11 and xtensor python (using CUDA to perform calculations on a GPU and OpenMP to perfrom them in parallel on a multi-core CPU). Cad2vox meanwhile is a pure python package that reads in and wrangles the mesh/greyscale data using meshio and acts as a user interface to Cudavox.
